newsitem.title: UK: Sterling trapped in tight range before UK budget.
newsitem.headline: Sterling trapped in tight range before UK budget.

text.p: 0905 GMT - Stg trapped before UK budget. Stg/mark over a pfennig above Tuesday's lows but 1.5 pfennigs below 5-year high.
* Stg/mark at 2.8945/55 vs 2.8875/85 late Tuesday in Europe. Cable at $1.6575/80 vs $1.6575/80 yesterday.
* UK reserves fell underlying $2 million in June, total actual reserves at $40.56 bln vs $40.57 bln in May.
* Budget speech at 1430 GMT, 4 bln stg net tightening seen.
* UK house prices rose by a s/a 0.3 pct in June, up 7.1 pct y/y, according to Halifax.
* Stg strength denting UK exporters' confidence, according to poll conducted by NCM and UK Institute of Export.
